statement: You are given a non-empty singly linked list whose node values, read from head to tail, are listed in values. Every value is 0, 1 or 2.
Rearrange the list so that all 0s come first, then all 1s, then all 2s.
Return the rearranged list, read from its head.

examples.explanation: The list holds two of each value, so it becomes two 0s, then two 1s, then two 2s.
There is one 0, one 1 and two 2s.
